C1564.title: Bybit $1.5 Billion Heist: Malicious Code Injected into Safe{Wallet} Frontend
C1564.summary: In February 2025, cryptocurrency exchange Bybit suffered the largest crypto theft in history, losing approximately $1.5 billion. Attackers compromised a Safe{Wallet} developer's machine and injected malicious JavaScript into the wallet's frontend interface.
